title: I am the bread of life

en.6:22: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
en.6:23: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
en.6:24: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
en.6:25: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
en.6:26: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
en.6:27: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
en.6:28: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
en.6:29: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
en.6:30: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
en.6:31: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
en.6:32: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
en.6:33: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
en.6:34: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
en.6:35: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
en.6:36: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
en.6:37: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
en.6:38: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
en.6:39: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
en.6:40: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
en.6:41: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
en.6:42: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”
en.6:44: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
en.6:45: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
en.6:46: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
en.6:47: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
en.6:48: I am the bread of life.
en.6:49: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
en.6:50: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
en.6:51: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
en.6:52: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
en.6:53: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
en.6:54: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
en.6:55: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
en.6:56: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
en.6:57: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
en.6:58: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
en.6:59: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
en.6:60: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
en.6:61: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?
en.6:62: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
en.6:63: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
en.6:64: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
en.6:65: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
